summary_md: This looks high-impact (auth/payments/sends/migrations). The lane planned it but paused for your go before doing anything. Plan: ## Plan for ARCA-61 — Saved watchlists not persisting across login  **What I did (read-only):** Traced the full watchlist chain — `WatchlistPage.tsx` → `client/src/lib/api.ts` → `modules/watchlist/handlers.ts` → `modules/watchlist/schema.ts` → `modules/auth` session/cookie logic. No edits made.  ### What the audit actually found Contrary to the ticket's assumption, the watchlist wiring looks **correct**, not obviously broken: - Every watchlist route requires a valid session and scopes queries by `user_id` derived from the session token (never from client input). - The frontend neve
